verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox or isolated test environment for Pipedream. The closest items are replaying a test event through a workflow ("Send Test Event") and `pd dev`, which syncs local edits to the deployed component. Neither is a separate environment isolated from production data or connected accounts. These are adjacent testing conveniences, not sandbox isolation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
